usage: skycued --config PATH [--replay FILE [--replay-speed N] [--replay-loop]] [options]
Forwards readsb's aircraft tracks to skycue clients:
  -h [ --help ]           show this help
  --version               print the version
  -c [ --config ] arg     skycue.toml (required)
  --set KEY=VALUE         override a config key for this run, e.g. --set 
                          inputs.readsb.host=10.0.0.2 (repeatable, a later one 
                          wins; above the SKYCUE_* environment)
  --dump-env              print the effective configuration (all layers and 
                          flags applied) as shell assignments 
                          SKYCUE_INPUTS_READSB_HOST='...', one per key, and 
                          exit; nothing is printed on an error (status 2)
  --convert-conf FILE     print the skycue.toml equivalent of an old 
                          skycue.conf (or skycue.overrides.conf) and exit
  --replay arg            play back a received-stream JSONL recording (or a 
                          readsb JSON capture) instead of connecting to readsb;
                          no UAT
  --replay-speed arg (=1) replay pacing: 1 = real time, 0 = unpaced
  --replay-loop           restart the replay at the end of the file
  --readsb-host arg       host of readsb's JSON port (overrides 
                          inputs.readsb.host)
  --dump978-host arg      host of dump978's raw port (overrides 
                          inputs.dump978.host)
  --no-uat                do not connect to dump978 (overrides 
                          inputs.dump978.enable)
  --no-readsb             do not connect to readsb (overrides 
                          inputs.readsb.enable)
  --inputs-file arg       override inputs.file (default: skycue.inputs.json in 
                          paths.state_dir, else next to the config; empty: not 
                          persisted)
  --cue-tcp-port arg      override cues.tcp_port (0: no listener)
  --www-dir arg           the web UI's files (default: 
                          <bin>/../share/skycue/www)
  --web-bind arg          override web.bind (numeric address)
  --web-port arg          override web.port (0: no web UI)
  --check-inputs          connect once to each configured TCP input (readsb, 
                          dump978, tcp_connect inputs of the inputs file), 
                          print one line per input, exit 0 when all connected, 
                          1 when one is not, 2 on a usage or configuration 
                          error; starts nothing else. Each check gives up after
                          3 s; a name lookup cannot be cancelled, so one that 
                          is still running then is abandoned and ends on the 
                          system resolver's own timeout
  --log-level arg (=info) debug, info, warn or error
